### ESSPL Business Travel Policy

The **ESSPL Business Travel Policy** outlines guidelines for both **domestic and international travel**.

## Key Policy Areas

- Travel tier classification
- City tier rules
- Travel approvals
- Expense reimbursement
- Allowances during travel

## Policy Overview

| Category | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Travel Type | Domestic / International |
| Approval | Manager Approval Required |
| Reimbursement | Expense Portal Submission |
| Documents | Receipts Required |

![Business Travel](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/d/d1/Airplane_silhouette.svg/640px-Airplane_silhouette.svg.png)

For full policy details refer to the official document.

### Travel Approval Process

Before booking any travel, **approval is required**.

## Approval Workflow

1. Employee submits travel request
2. Reporting manager reviews the request
3. Finance verifies budget
4. Travel desk confirms booking

| Step | Responsible Team |
|-----|------------------|
| Request Submission | Employee |
| Approval | Reporting Manager |
| Budget Check | Finance |
| Booking | Travel Desk |

![Approval Workflow](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3b/Flowchart_example.svg/640px-Flowchart_example.svg.png)

# Travel Allowances

Employees traveling for official purposes may receive **allowances**.

## Allowance Types

| Allowance Type | Description |
|----------------|-------------|
| Accommodation | Hotel stay during travel |
| Meals | Food expenses during travel |
| Transport | Local transportation |

These allowances may vary depending on:

- Employee designation
- City tier
- Duration of travel

![Allowance](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/e1/Wallet.svg/640px-Wallet.svg.png)

### Travel Expense Reimbursement

Employees can claim reimbursement for travel related expenses.

## Eligible Expenses

| Expense Type | Example |
|--------------|---------|
| Flights | Air tickets |
| Hotels | Accommodation |
| Transport | Taxi / Cab |
| Meals | Food during travel |

### Important

- Keep **all receipts**
- Submit claims in the **expense portal**
- Claims must be approved by the manager
